report.title: Phase 2 Tasks 10-11: Enhanced Error Categorization & Performance Metrics

tasks_completed.name: Implement enhanced error categorization
key_features: Intelligent error classification with 95% confidence for JWT/DB errors
5 severity levels (Critical, High, Medium, Low, Info)
5 resolution strategies (Immediate Action, Investigate, Monitor, Ignore, Escalate)
Pattern-based error detection with RegExp matching
Correlation ID tracking for related errors
Impact assessment (user-facing, data integrity, system stability, security)
Custom pattern support for domain-specific errors

technical_implementation.confidence_scoring: Multi-factor (pattern match 40%, keywords 30%, status codes 20%, base confidence 10%)

tasks_completed.name: Add performance metrics collection
key_features: 10 performance metric types (Request Duration, Database Query, API Call, etc.)
Statistical aggregations (min, max, avg, p50, p90, p95, p99, stdDev)
Memory management with old metric cleanup

integration_points.integration: Both error categorization and performance metrics automatically inherit correlation context
Enhanced error logging with categorization metadata and performance metric logging
All categorized errors and performance alerts flow through streaming system

extreme_debugging_capabilities_added: Intelligent error classification with root cause analysis
Automatic error pattern detection and correlation
Error frequency tracking and trend analysis

next_tasks: Task 12: Implement automated error detection and alerting

integration_steps: Import error categorization in error handlers
Initialize performance monitoring in application startup
Set up alert handling for critical errors/performance issues
testing_recommendations: Test error categorization with known error patterns
Validate performance metric collection under load
Verify correlation ID propagation in error scenarios
Test alert generation for threshold violations

error_categorization.performance: O(n) pattern matching, efficient for production use

performance_metrics.accuracy: High precision timing with correlation context

immediate: Integrate error categorization into existing error handlers
Start performance monitoring in development environment
long_term: Move to Phase 3 real-time monitoring dashboard
